dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor protrusion on the left lateral margin relative to the right; otherwise smooth and continuous.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey median pixel intensity consistent with sub-adult pigmentation.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey median pixel intensity consistent with sub-adult pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters localized near the anterior and mid-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Three distinct, parallel horizontal white scars located on the dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible topological disruptions at the site of the horizontal scars and a narrow longitudinal indentation along the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent horizontal scars with a secondary thin longitudinal scar extending posteriorly along the midline.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial arrangement of the three horizontal scars intersecting a vertical midline marking.
